reading.zh: 按触发时序阅读：待办产生先写站内信（inbox）并异步发邮件（mail）；抄送提供只读可见性（cc）；节点或补件超时后只催办、不自动跳过也不自动升级（reminder）。
reading.en: Read in trigger order: a new task writes the in-app message (inbox) and asynchronously sends mail (mail); CC grants read-only visibility (cc); an overdue node or supplement only triggers a reminder (reminder), never an automatic skip or escalation.
